column1: # RQ6 real-history worksheet — squidex 7.20.0..7.21.0. Fill ONLY `label` and `note`. label = one of: architectural | non-architectural | extraction-noise. architectural = a real change of the system's build-graph structure a maintainer would want flagged
column2: non-architectural = a real change with no architectural significance (e.g. tooling/test/packaging churn)
column3: extraction-noise = not a real change of the code (extractor artefact). hint = commits between the releases touching the finding's build file(s). Rater instructions: docs/rq6-history-labelling-runbook.md.
